statement: An id a document defines that a route escape names (a policy id, a rate limit rule id) reaches a host's log line and the control plane's ROUTES finding only escaped: a control character or an unpaired surrogate is written as its \uXXXX escape (Identifiers.printable), and each part longer than 128 characters is cut, never inside a surrogate pair, saying how long it was. No document forges a log line on the hosts that install it.
guards: document:RouteEscapesTest#an id that would forge a line is shown escaped, and a long one cut
control:RouteFindingsTest#an id that would forge a line is shown escaped
spring-boot:RouteEscapeReviewTest#an id that would forge a line is logged escaped
